name: pref_ref

metrics.coefficient_convention: Pauli strings; full on-site hz counted once; absent terms excluded

ground_gap_semantics: Legacy raw Lanczos spacing; not a gap after momentum completion. Use explicit derived fields.
gap_counting_resolved_multiplicity_seman: Zero means at least two ground vectors within the stated numerical energy tolerance; null means no certified multiplicity-counting gap.
gap_above_manifold_status: Uncertified low-spectrum completeness; translation completion only completes the orbit of returned ground vectors.
